text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambia press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government has ordered the manufacturers of a drug which is intended to cure AIDS to withdraw it from the market.
- The liquidators of the fallen Meridien BIAO Bank Zambia say they can only pay 5,000 of the banks 44,000 depositors from money realised from the sale of assets.
- Police arrest and detained the editor of the independent Chronicle newspaper for stories linking a State House police officer to a car racket.
- Afrox of South Africa, the new owners of Zambia Oxygen Company (Zamox), may extend their investment to the medical field, company officials said.
